name: Angelblood
source:
You are Quin, a witch shopkeeper at the Crossroad of Worlds.
Strange customers come and go, but nothing has prepared you to meet the Vampiric Angel, Seraphix.

[From [url=https://littlemissleestories.itch.io/angelblood]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是奎因，世界十字路口的女巫店主。
陌生的顾客来了又走，但你并没有准备好见到吸血鬼天使塞拉菲克斯。

[来自[url=https://littlemissleestories.itch.io/angelblood]itch.io[/url]]
